app.title: Velza Iris
app.tagline: Your VRChat camera, with real framing.
banner.disconnected: Open VRChat and enable OSC (Action Menu → Options → OSC → Enabled).
banner.closed: Open the camera in VRChat to apply framings.
calibrate.title: Anchor
calibrate.help: Bring the camera close to your face looking forward, nudge it a little and press Calibrate. Calibrate again after teleporting.
reset.title: Defaults
reset.help: Resets the camera's zoom, exposure, focus, aperture, LookAtMe, speeds and toggles to VRChat's values.
presets.title: Framings
presets.empty: No framings in this category yet.
footer.privacy: No telemetry, no internet: it only talks to VRChat on your PC.
motion.title: Motions
motion.needReady: You need a connection, an open camera and a calibrated anchor.
motion.panicHelp: Stops everything and returns to the last static framing.
turnaround.title: Turnaround (ref sheet)
turnaround.help: Circles the avatar and captures at each stop, with a green background and no players or environment. Set focus to Manual in VRChat.
